interpretation: The ESA/Hubble five-observatory composite release supplies each component on the same 5290 by 5290 pixel TAN grid, with identical AVM reference dimensions, reference pixel, reference sky value, scales and rotation. Transfer the whole grid through the independently star-verified optical component. This preserves publisher interband calibration and does not measure stars or knots in this band.
limits: The optical bridge qualifies direction and scale of the publisher grid. Unknown residual instrument-to-instrument offsets, beams, changing PWN wisps, and distinct observing epochs remain; no optical-shell fit to X-ray or radio knots is used.
